column1: Knowledge

The demo as-of date is 2026-10-12. Any question about today or now refers to that date. It falls in fiscal quarter FY27-Q2; the latest complete month is September 2026 and the latest telemetry and cloud consumption month is 2026-09.

Americas East is the region whose renewal rate has slipped this fiscal year: about 90 percent of ARR due renewed in FY26 and about 79 percent so far in FY27 while the other three regions stayed within three points of their FY26 rate.

Two things drive the Americas East slip. The KS-7000 array family reaches end of support on 2027-01-31 so customers are holding off on renewing support and KeelOS subscriptions on those arrays. And a cluster of P1 production-down cases followed the KeelOS 9.14.2 upgrade wave in July and August 2026 (defect KB-2026-0917 fixed in 9.14.3).

About 28 million dollars of Americas East ARR comes up for renewal in the next 90 days (2026-10-13 to 2027-01-10) and roughly 13 million of it is flagged AT_RISK by the renewals team. End of support product and Open P1 case are the two main risk reasons.

Brightwater Mutual Insurance (CUST-0001) is a large Americas East enterprise account with a big KS-7000 estate and several P1 cases on KeelOS 9.14.2; it is the account to open first when discussing the renewal slip. Tidewater Health Alliance and Pinecrest Regional Health are in the same position.

Finance ARR for September 2026 is about 500 million dollars. The Sales Ops ARR figure for the same month is about 5 percent higher because it still counts roughly 27 million dollars of lapsed contracts whose renewal opportunities are open in Salesforce. The gap is widest in Americas East at about 7 percent.

When a question compares Finance ARR with Sales Ops ARR answer from V_ARR_FINANCE_VS_SALESOPS: FINANCE_ARR is the certified figure and LAPSED_OPEN_ARR is the amount Sales Ops adds. Finance removes a contract the day it lapses; Sales Ops keeps it until the opportunity is Closed Lost.

Keelstone Cloud Volumes consumption in June to September 2026 was about 78 percent higher than the same months of 2025. At the same time 27 enterprise accounts have consumed less than 60 percent of their FY27 cloud commit; those accounts are listed by V_CLOUD_COMMIT_UTILIZATION with IS_UNDER_UTILIZED = 1.

Altura Technology Partners is the Americas East partner whose support attach rate on new systems fell from about 77 percent in FY26 to about 61 percent in FY27. Northwind Integrators and the other large partners held near 76 percent.

KeelOS 9.14.2 was released on 2026-07-01 and carries defect KB-2026-0917 (controller failover loop during takeover and giveback on KS-7000 and KS-9000 controllers). KeelOS 9.14.3 released 2026-09-15 is the fix. Americas East systems were upgraded to 9.14.2 first through the AutoPulse managed upgrade campaign.

Since July 2026 there have been 66 P1 cases on KeelOS 9.14.2 in Americas East versus four or fewer in any other region. Their case notes record customers questioning the January renewal and asking for migration quotes to KS-9000.

The KS-7000 family (KS-7200 KS-7400 KS-7600) was end of sale on 2025-10-31 and ends support on 2027-01-31 under bulletin PLB-2026-014 dated 2026-06-15. KS-9300 and KS-9500 are the migration targets and KS-7000 Extended Support (SUP-EXT7K) is available to 2028-01-31.
The fiscal year ends 30 April. FY26 is 2025-05-01 to 2026-04-30 and FY27 is 2026-05-01 to 2027-04-30. Fiscal quarters are Q1 May-Jul Q2 Aug-Oct Q3 Nov-Jan Q4 Feb-Apr.
Renewal rate and attach rate must be rolled up in dollars or counts (SUM of numerator over SUM of denominator) rather than by averaging the rate column.

Product family on a support contract or a KeelOS Core subscription refers to the covered array's family. Support SKUs are Standard Support Premium Support Mission Critical Support and KS-7000 Extended Support.
Bookings in ORDERS are total contract value and include one-time hardware. They are not ARR. ARR comes only from recurring contracts in force on a date.
A P1 case means production down. P2 is severely degraded P3 minor impact and P4 a question. Mission Critical Support customers expect a two hour onsite response on P1.
The region names are Americas East Americas West EMEA and APAC. Americas East includes the US East Coast Canada and Brazil accounts and is managed by Victoria Lang.
RISK_FLAG and RISK_REASON on a renewal opportunity are the renewals team's assessment entered in Salesforce. Present them as the team's view not as a prediction.

Source systems: orders and contracts come from SAP S/4HANA; renewal opportunities from Salesforce; support cases from ServiceNow; installed base and telemetry from AutoPulse. The DATA_DICTIONARY table records the business owner and source system of each metric.
